This document provides details and evidence for an attempt to replicate a finding from Ishida
et al. (1) showing an association between exposure to intimate partner violence and mental
health in women from Paraguay.

targets.authors: Ishida K, Stupp P, Melian M, Serbanescu F, Goodwin M.
targets.title: Exploring the associations between intimate partner violence and women’s mental health: Evidence from a population-based study in Paraguay.
targets.evidence_quote:
This document provides details and evidence for an attempt to replicate a finding from Ishida
et al. (1) showing an association between exposure to intimate partner violence and mental
health in women from Paraguay.
targets.outcome_quote:
The coefficient from Ishida that we attempted to replicate was the odds ratio for IPV-Last
12 months-Emotional = 1.58, 95% confidence interval = 1.35, 1.86. Our replication estimate
using the Nicaraguan data was 1.54 with a 95% confidence interval of 1.39 to 1.70. A test of
whether this coefficient was different from zero generated a test statistic of χ2 = 71.07 with
1 degree of freedom and a p-value of 3.4e-17. Thus, according to the criteria laid out above,
this replication was successful.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall successful replication verdict using Nicaraguan data to test the Paraguayan finding.
